text: Built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola is the strongest Arena deck: from Bari 7★ it usually beats Rye at equal spec.
detail: Not always: Angel and Rockstar Rye decks are reported beating 8–10★ Bari. Order: set Bari > set Rye >>> plain Bari > plain Rye.

text: The Rye deck is the value pick: it beats Bari up to about 6★ and any unset Bari deck.
detail: Under 5★ a Bari deck is 'a junk deck' against Rye.

text: Most-run Arena lineup: the Rye / Skating Queen / Grapevine deck, 13.0% of crumb.gg's sample.
detail: Grouped: Rye builds 31%, the Rumble standard 12 24%, the old five-ranged deck 15% and falling.

text: Rye deck flex: Rockstar. Its shield lands inside Bari's first dive.
detail: One mirror report has the Rockstar version beat Skating + Grapevine. Angel for Herb is disputed.

text: Six Skill Haste lines are out: Bari decks run none, Rye decks three.
detail: Rye decks swap bottom-right haste for DR + crit RES and survive the opening.

text: Defenses keep losing to equal attackers: attack late before the 00:00 settlement.
detail: Cause unknown. The 10-08 patch only adds help text on merc perks.

text: Keep an accuracy preset: evasion decks beat unprepared attackers at half their power.
Captain Milk at merc Lv.4 with Armor Repair + Passion Pay; keep Milk ATK #1.
Re-check after 10-08: the Lv.120 cap counts in Arena, and Chardonnay is new.
The standard 12 still holds the top 100 on Season 1's last day.
detail: 9 of the 12 fully revealed top-100 teams are exactly it.

text: Herb shows less often in the top 10; hidden slots hide what replaced her.
detail: Herb fell from 67 to 44 top-100 slots. Rockstar shows once in the top 10 (#3).

text: Third pet is moving from Hot Doggie to Icy Birdie.
detail: Icy Birdie rose from 12 to 45 in the top 100.

text: Rye decks win mid-ladder, even 12M down, but lose to finished Bari at the top.
From about 10th to 50th, half the Bari decks reportedly run Vampire for Cherry Cola.
Carry two accuracy lines or the stage preset: evasion defenses spread higher up.
Above 2,000 points, 2–3 defenders are hidden: read the visible core and assume the standard 12.
Season 2 opens 10-08 with an unannounced buff. The Charge buff carries Bari and Oven.
Top-100 rewards need 3,000 points; ranks 101 to ~2,300 share Elite Master 1 rewards.
